items.title: Yusef Lateef — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I’ve uh witnessed in Copenhagen at the [Jazzhus] Montemartre, uh Ben Webster, one night he played The Beatles song Yesterdays

ctx.x: Just knocking doesn’t get anyone to open the door. Um...like, in time, perhaps, it will happen. Like Ben Webster said, I remember he said, one day Ben Webster said, “A few slip under the fence.”
